issue: settings application entry differs between font and wifi requests
interpretation: Both goals selected the same Settings icon in all six isolated calls. Wi-Fi had a score at the 0.8 boundary once. The historical failure was not reproduced and cannot be attributed exclusively to low confidence. No physical click or Wi-Fi setting change was performed.

Accept bounded legacy-server model waits at a native launcher as a reason to offer the same explicit entry, without automatic icon tapping or lowering the model confidence threshold.
